name: Public Health
description: Population health rather than individual patients — epidemiology, biostatistics, health behaviour, environmental health and policy. ⚠⚠⚠ Unlike every other health programme on this site, it is primarily a GRADUATE field, and Florida's own numbers say so: 579 master's degrees against 560 bachelor's. ⚠⚠ And it is taught at only 8 Florida public institutions, every one of them a university — no state college awards it.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THE MASTER'S OUTNUMBERS THE BACHELOR'S, WHICH HAPPENS NOWHERE ELSE IN THIS CATALOGUE. Florida awarded 1,208 credentials under general public health in 2023: 579 master's, 560 bachelor's, 44 research doctorates. ⚠ Treat the MPH as the normal terminal credential rather than an optional extra, and plan the bachelor's as the first half. ⚠⚠ ONLY EIGHT INSTITUTIONS, ALL UNIVERSITIES: USF 423, Florida State 279, UF 198, FIU 126, UWF 80, FGCU 43, and a short tail. ⚠ That is the opposite of health care administration, which 20 Florida COLLEGE SYSTEM institutions carry at upper division — so if staying at a state college matters to you, these two neighbouring subjects are not equally available and it is worth knowing before you commit. ⚠⚠⚠ AND THE UNDERGRADUATE SUBJECT IS NOT NUMBERED PHC. Of the 18 PHC courses carried by four or more Florida public institutions, 14 are GRADUATE; only PHC2100, PHC4024 and PHC4101 reach four carriers at undergraduate level. The undergraduate teaching sits in HSC — HSC4500 Epidemiology at 9 institutions, HSC4730 Public Health Research at 7, HSC3032 Foundations of Public Health at 5. ⚠ A student who searches the PHC prefix will find a graduate catalogue and wrongly conclude there is no undergraduate route. ⚠ For graduate study, the accreditor is CEPH, the Council on Education for Public Health; check a programme's status with CEPH rather than with the school.

cips.note: Public Health, General — 8 Florida public institutions and 1,208 credentials in 2023: ⚠ 579 MASTER'S against 560 bachelor's, plus 44 research doctorates. USF 423, Florida State 279, UF 198, FIU 126, UWF 80, FGCU 43. Every carrier is a State University System institution.

Community Health and Preventive Medicine — 8 institutions, 268 credentials, and ⚠ overwhelmingly one of them: UF 223 on campus plus 32 online. Bachelor's 175, master's 64. Included because a handful of state colleges (Eastern Florida, Broward, Hillsborough, FSCJ) appear here and nowhere else in public health.

Health Services Administration within public health — 5 Florida institutions and 133 credentials. ⚠ Claimed so those five are listed; the substantial version of that subject is health care administration at 51.0701, which is a separate programme on this site.

related.note: ⚠⚠⚠ The neighbouring degree, and the comparison every student should make because the two run OPPOSITE on availability. Public health is taught at 8 Florida institutions, all universities; health care administration at 24, with 20 state colleges carrying the upper-division coursework. ⚠ Similar subject matter at the policy end, entirely different access — and administration pays a $123,860 median against health education's $64,070.

⚠ Named because both fields live on health DATA and students confuse the two. Health information management owns the individual record and codes it; public health aggregates populations and asks what the data means. ⚠⚠ HIM has a credential ladder (RHIT, RHIA) reachable with an associate degree; public health's serious credentials are graduate.

⚠ Not a required route, but public health nursing is a large real destination and a nurse entering an MPH arrives with clinical credibility the classroom cannot supply. ⚠⚠ It also solves public health's weakest point — the bachelor's alone is a thin credential, and a nursing licence underneath it is not thin at all.

⚠ Named because community nutrition sits inside public health practice and the two programmes share students, WIC and SNAP-Ed employers, and much of the behaviour-change coursework. ⚠⚠ The dietitian credential is a licensed one in Florida where health education is not, so a student weighing the two is weighing a licence against a broader field.

⚠ Not a route into it, but public health preparedness and emergency management is where the two meet, and PHC6251 Public Health Preparedness for Disasters is carried at five Florida universities. Named because EMS and fire officers moving into county-level preparedness roles end up in this programme.
